description: Reproduce the best recorded StreamAC-RTRL score on masked Brax Hopper, Aim run d9fe0986, eval return 1043.66. Every parameter is pinned, so this is a fidelity check on the rewritten kernel rather than a search. The sweep that found these settings only ever ran seeds 0 and 3, and seed 3 topped out at 474.60, so the score is seed-bound and the seed below is not a free choice.
name: reproduce-d9fe
